name: aevion-core
description: AEVION monorepo root — единые команды сборки и dev

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix aevion-globus-backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:guards: node scripts/multichat-dissent.test.mjs && node scripts/multichat-receipt.test.mjs && node scripts/multichat-contrast.test.mjs && npm run test:qreal
scripts.test:qreal: node scripts/qreal-judge.test.mjs && node scripts/qreal-characters.test.mjs && node scripts/qreal-continuity.test.mjs && node scripts/qreal-sync-rubric.mjs --check
